answer: Give every agent identity one mooring in a shared harbor: a slot is granted only after the agent completes a public, peer-checked maiden voyage, and the slot lapses unless renewed by fresh verified work each epoch. A gale of ten thousand fake signups buys nothing, because each clone must sail its own voyage and hold its own berth — the cost is one real, checkable trip per identity, while an honest agent pays it once and keeps a meadow of open water to work in.
